newsitem.title: UK: IBCA assigns rating to Alpha Credit Bank.
newsitem.headline: IBCA assigns rating to Alpha Credit Bank.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Friday it had assigned an individual rating of B to Greece's Alpha Credit Bank.
IBCA said that the bank's Legal rating of 2 was unchanged.

"The bank has demonstarted a good profitability record in recent years and profits are expected to increase significantly in 1996, although strong competition on both sides of the balance sheet continues to put pressure on margins," IBCA said in a statement.
It said the bank's asset quality had remained sound, depite the comparatively weak domestic operation environment.
"The bank has a strong and stable retail deposit base and is well capitalised," IBCA said.
